name: Aragorn, King of Gondor — "If you're the monarch, creatures can't block" (not the monarch)
notes: Found by tests/audit.py once targeted can't-rules were audited (2026-11-17). The "if" of a later sentence was dropped as gating nothing when that sentence had no get/gain/have verb, so "If you're the monarch, creatures can't block this turn" applied to every creature whether or not you were the monarch (cards-parser.js, Pattern D: a can't-rule now counts as an effect). The can't-rule takes the condition of its own sentence (_getConditionOfOwnSentence), so the first sentence's target is not gated by it. See also aragorn-monarch-creatures-cant-block-monarch.
